name: The Doleris vanish
summary: The Doleris civilization supposedly vanished around 700 years ago.

name: The Ophrasian War
summary: A cataclysmic conflict that lasted for forty years, reshaping the borders of Maltona and leaving the Boundless Vale scarred by a new, dark form of magic.

name: Nihilium appears
summary: A crystallization of Void energy starts to plague the Material Plane, the result of a botched spell at the end of the Ophrasian War.
